A2.evidence: PCC-CNN (Sec. III.B) uses Conv1D over the feature vector; no windows, time steps or sequences of consecutive records/CAN frames described.

A3.evidence: No normalization/encoding described; Sec. III only: 'the utils file is used for data massaging and distributing the data across the local clients.' Not stated in Sec. III-IV.

A4.evidence: Local epochs stated (Sec. IV.C: 'The model was trained for 3 epochs with the NSL-KDD dataset and 3 epochs with the Car-Hacking dataset'); number of FL rounds not stated ('repeated iteratively until the model converges').

A5.evidence: Tables 5-6 compare Centralized vs Federated accuracy; no statement that centralized models used the same epochs/budget (Sec. III-IV).

A6.evidence: Tables 5-6: centralized and federated LR and PCC-CNN results from authors' own Testbed 1/2 experiments; no numbers copied from other papers.

A7.evidence: Tables 5-6 report only accuracy and loss (plus time); no MCC/balanced accuracy/G-mean.

A8.evidence: Sec. III, Testbed 2: 'employing four different versions of the NSL-KDD dataset, with each version assigned to an individual client' — versions/distribution not specified.

A9.evidence: No repeated runs, averages or dispersion stated in Sec. IV / Tables 5-6.

A10.evidence: NSL-KDD and Car-Hacking evaluated separately (Tables 5-6); no cross-dataset or held-out-dataset evaluation.

A11.evidence: No code link; Sec. III mentions 'client, server, and utils python files' but no public repository.
